data.name: King of Bali
data.detailed_description:
Destaque


Acerca do jogo

“King of Bali” is an adult comedic harem dating-sim filled with hilarious jokes and loveable characters. How many people can you charm in Bali?

Features
  • Cool R'n'B Background music
  • Simplified Chinese and Russian
  • Many CGs
  • Multiple Endings


Plot

Billy Bega is most famous to the world for his 2007 hit “Kissing your Heart”. It’s been ten years since, and Billy is yet to produce another song to even make the charts. In many ways, Billy has accepted his position in life as a “one hit wonder”. After his invitation to play in SXSW is cancelled, Billy decides to go on a vacation to Bali, a popular holiday destination in Indonesia, instead to look for inspiration for his new album. There he meets some very interesting and lovely ladies!

Characters

Rosie Lowe (23) [Edmonton, Alberta, Canada) – Rosie is a freelance journalist working for a major newspaper’s office (she won’t tell anyone outside work which newspaper it is) in Hong Kong. She decided to go to Bali for the weekend to get away from the stresses of journalism.

Madison Sims (26) [Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia] - A recent divorcee who has travelled to Bali by herself to erase the feelings she had for her ex-husband and to party as she has never done before in her life! Madison is confident and outgoing!

Kendra Charleston (24) [Gary, Indiana, USA] – Kendra ss a lounge singer at the hotel where Billy is staying. She dreams of moving to Los Angeles one day to try to make it as a singer or actress. Kendra is sultry, ambitious and determined.

Queenie O’Hara (30) [Liverpool, UK] – After working for eight years at a banking job in London, Queenie decided to finally follow her dreams and set up a bistro in Bali. Queenie is friendly, welcoming and warm.

Elaine Tuttle (31) [Atlanta, Georgia, USA] – Billy’s booking agent and one of his closest friends. Equally cunning and charming, Elaine is a sharp and funny go-getter.

reviews.review:
Do you wanna be a king? Well, too bad, Elvis already took the title, so don't expect that. Who can you really be after playing this game?

I'm somewhat of an enthusiast of low-budget VNs, hoping to find a diamond in the rough. I start as an open-minded optimist, assuming that maybe there is enough quality, or at least enough traces of effort, inside every product I engage with. However, sometimes, no matter how much I dig, I can't uncover any redeeming quality.
So, what do we have here?
Firstly, there is very little in terms of story here. Bland and brief story setting and character introduction, not allowing the reader to form any connection or care for the protagonist. Maybe it was intentional to create an unlikeable, washed, one-hit-wonder that we play as. He is defined more by his incessant need for validation and skin color than by his actions. It was a sad spectacle to observe. 
Secondly, there is an unconvincing nanpa and throwaway heroines. All events are rushed and repetitive, devoid of realism or development. I have yet to meet people acting in a similar fashion to the one presented here. Maybe I just lack experience of visiting cheap bars at popular tourist destinations, I wonder. On top of that, the tone of the conversations during certain scenes is childish. They are written in a low iq teenager style, ruining the mood of the scenes. 
Thirdly, the meaninglessness of choices is puzzling. There is a good number of them, yet only a handful matter at all. The few important ones either initiate an event or decide the outcome of the interaction with the heroines. For example, you might think that lying has some consequences, as the achievement suggests, but nope, just the last choice decides. Another example is the choice of the bar to go to, no difference. Also, no matter what happens and how many times you see the volcano, the ending scene is always the same. The events have zero impact on the good old Bega. He's always inspired, no matter what, eh?

Moreover, there are also several annoying technical aspects. The number of save slots is way too low, making choice experimentation tedious. There is no quick save option. The log is limited to what can be displayed on the screen only; everything before that is gone. You can't save when making a choice. All screen options displayed at the bottom of the screen are stupidly squished together, making missclick more likely. No indication when auto mode is active. I believe this vn was made in Tyranno builder, so maybe these are the limitations of the program itself, but I have my doubts. 
On the bright side, the protagonist's thoughts are presented in yellow color and narration in blue. Unnecessary, but might be helpful to some players.

The menu design couldn't be plainer and simpler. Same for the character art: low detail, amateurish, weird body proportions. There is only one motionless, tachie per character, making the scenes feel lifeless. Worse yet, the lewd sections disappoint as well. The only CGs this vn has are displayed during the hscenes, and they suck. Don't expect more than modest nudity, displaying the heroine in a boring pose. There is also a
repetitive gimmick, an exploding volcano vid, playing in all scenes. 
The backgrounds are probably the best element ot the design, and most are just blurred photos. I understand this is a budget vn, and the need to employ cost-cutting measures, but this is one of the most visually bereft vns I've seen.

The devs made a mess with achievements as well. The activation of some does not match the description. I unlocked the King of Bali achievement before I even met all the heroines. Similarly, the BALINESE HOLIDAY appeared on my list when I still had three more achievements to unlock. 

In conclusion, budget VNs don't carry a lot of promise, but writing and effort can still compensate for lower quality. Unfortunately, I see too many shortcomings on display here to conclude with a positive note. It's one of the few cases when I can't recommend even trying the game in question. Disappointing, as I had some expectations: 3.3/10
